fees.notes: StudyMalaysia course page: international fees RM57,645. MSU official programme pages publish Malaysian fees only; no official international fee schedule available. Source: https://studymalaysia.com/what/course/MSU/0005948/ (accessed 2026-09-18).

requirements.general: i. Pass SPM or equivalent with at least credits in THREE (3) subjects, including Mathematics and ONE (1) relevant science / technical / vocational subject AND a pass in English; OR ii. Pass STPM or equivalent with a pass in Mathematics, English and ONE (1) relevant science / technical / vocational subject at the SPM level; OR iii. Recognised Certificate in Engineering / Engineering Technology or equivalent; OR iv. Recognised related Vocational and Technical / Skills Certificate or equivalent with ONE (1) year of relevant work experience or a minimum of ONE (1) semester of a bridging programme. International students: TOEFL 500 or IELTS 5.0 or equivalent Note: This programme does not lead to recognition by the Board of Engineers Malaysia (BEM).
